0022600193.text: The Orlando Magic (2-5, 0-4 at home) are on a two-game losing streak and sit 12th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, while the Golden State Warriors (5-3, 3-1 at home) are riding a five-game winning streak and sit 2nd in the Pacific and 8th in the West. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Golden State is without Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and the last meeting was on December 22, 2025, when the Magic lost 120-97 in San Francisco.
